body:
### Summary

I have a `pyproject.toml` file that has an author field that looks like this:
```toml
[project]
# ...
author = [{name = "rzuckerm"}]
# ...
```
The above is allowed in TOML 1.0 since I can load my `pyproject.toml` file using the old [toml](https://pypi.org/project/toml) package, and that package only supports TOML 1.0. However, when I do `uv build --sdist`, I notice there are `pyproject.toml` and a `pyproject.toml.orig` files in the tarball. The `pyproject.toml.orig` file should not be there.

### Platform

Ubuntu 24.04 amd64

### Version

uv 0.12.0

### Python version

Python 3.12.3
title: author field in pyproject.toml is being interpret as TOML 1.1 by uv build
